svg.title: Pfalz study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Pfalz; 2: Deidesheim; 3: Bad Dürkheim; 4: Kallstadt; 5: Königsbach; 6: Neustadt an der Weinstraße; 7: Laumersheim; 8: Birkweiler; 9: Schweigen; 10: Rhodt unter Rietburg; 11: Wöschbach; 12: Kleinkarlbach

g.title: 6 · Neustadt an der Weinstraße: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.

choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
